verdict.rationale: Benchmarks and latency/recall numbers are a fair question for a vector database, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack contains no published benchmarks or measured latency/recall figures. The only performance-related items are anecdotal community remarks (e.g. "It's fast, good accuracy"), which are not published measurements and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published benchmarks or measured latency/recall numbers backing the database's performance claims
